t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colored gnomes also match baskets but honestly this was written weird and I don't understand what they meant fully.

vb_textbox.text: There are 6 different colored gnomes.  Each gnome matches one basket for the mushrooms.  Once you know which gnomes go with each basket. You just have to know which basket to pick.  My baskets were yellow and red.  The way I remembered was that the yellow basket went with blue, brown yellow.  All the colors had yellow but no red in them.  The red basket were purple, pink and a reddish brown all with red in them.  The baskets will go down in value like 1-2 mushrooms then you should pick the other basket.  So if Red is doing well and suddenly goes down to 1-2 mushrooms start picking the yellow gnomes.
